author: DAN KOE
text: Going on a walk is a micro dopamine detox.

topReplies.author: Dickie Bush
topReplies.text: This is why my best writing comes immediately after a 60-minute walk.

topReplies.author: WOLF
topReplies.text: And it's great for creativity as well

topReplies.author: Big Dad Energy | BDEX
topReplies.text: Probably my favorite time to meditate and realign my thinking.

topReplies.author: Atif Hussain
topReplies.text: I'm just going to spend the rest of my life walking then

topReplies.author: Sufyan Maan, M.Eng
topReplies.text:
Agree! Long walks
In nature
No phone
No music
No tech 
Just you and nature

topReplies.author: ADONIS
topReplies.text: It clears your head and resets your mood without needing anything else

topReplies.author: The Founders Club
topReplies.text: And it clears your mind for bigger ideas.
